Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3
Source: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster
Distribution: npm leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3
License: MIT (leaflet-markercluster-LICENSE.txt)
Bundled locally for offline marker rendering; basemap tiles still need internet.
leaflet.markercluster.js is the distribution build with the optional source-map
reference removed. MarkerCluster.css is unchanged. Cluster badges are styled in
../marker_clusters.css. Dash loads leaflet.js before leaflet.markercluster.js.
